artifact.text: scrambled insertion is ordered by tick. Input: {"events":[["late",8,0],["early",2,0]]}. Expected bounded report: ["early","late"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

equal ticks retain insertion order. Input: {"events":[["first",2,0],["second",2,0]]}. Expected bounded report: ["first","second"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

priority resolves a same-tick tie. Input: {"events":[["normal",2,1],["urgent",2,0]]}. Expected bounded report: ["urgent","normal"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

priority never moves an event before its tick. Input: {"events":[["later",4,-9],["earlier",1,9]]}. Expected bounded report: ["earlier","later"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
an empty calendar yields no fabricated event. Input: {"events":[]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

tick zero is a schedulable boundary. Input: {"events":[["zero",0,0],["one",1,0]]}. Expected bounded report: ["zero","one"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an exclusive horizon omits its endpoint. Input: {"events":[["at",5,0],["before",4,0]],"until":5}. Expected bounded report: ["before"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
a future-only calendar is empty at cutoff. Input: {"events":[["future",8,0]],"until":3}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

duplicate event labels are refused. Input: {"events":[["dup",1,0],["dup",2,0]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_event"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

negative delay is refused before scheduling. Input: {"events":[["past",-1,0]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"invalid_tick"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
planned start finish reaches recorded. Input: {"events":["start","finish"]}. Expected bounded report: "recorded". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
an untouched trial stays planned. Input: {"events":[]}. Expected bounded report: "planned". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
a started trial stays running until finish. Input: {"events":["start"]}. Expected bounded report: "running". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
pause resume preserves a running trial. Input: {"events":["start","pause","resume"]}. Expected bounded report: "running". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
pause without resume does not finish. Input: {"events":["start","pause"]}. Expected bounded report: "paused". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
cancellation before start is terminal. Input: {"events":["cancel"]}. Expected bounded report: "cancelled". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
cancellation after pause is terminal. Input: {"events":["start","pause","cancel"]}. Expected bounded report: "cancelled". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
finish before start is refused. Input: {"events":["finish"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"invalid_transition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

a recorded trial cannot restart. Input: {"events":["start","finish","start"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"invalid_transition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an unknown trigger is refused. Input: {"events":["start","promote"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"invalid_transition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
two simultaneous arrivals use FIFO. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,3],["b",0,2]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,3],["b",3,5]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

idle gaps do not create waiting time. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,1],["b",5,2]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,1],["b",5,7]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an overlapping arrival waits for release. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,4],["b",2,1]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,4],["b",4,5]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

zero service consumes no simulated duration. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,0],["b",0,2]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,0],["b",0,2]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

unsorted jobs are normalized by arrival. Input: {"jobs":[["b",4,1],["a",0,2]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,2],["b",4,5]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
an empty queue performs zero service. Input: {"jobs":[]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

arrival exactly at release starts immediately. Input: {"jobs":[["a",1,3],["b",4,2]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",1,4],["b",4,6]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

three queued jobs preserve cumulative waiting. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,2],["b",1,3],["c",1,1]]}. Expected bounded report: [["a",0,2],["b",2,5],["c",5,6]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
negative service duration is refused. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,-1]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"invalid_job"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

repeated job labels are refused. Input: {"jobs":[["a",0,1],["a",2,1]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_job"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
a repeated identical event is applied once. Input: {"events":[["e1",2],["e1",2]]}. Expected bounded report: 2. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
distinct events accumulate in order. Input: {"events":[["e1",2],["e2",3]]}. Expected bounded report: 5. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

conflicting duplicate payload is refused. Input: {"events":[["e1",2],["e1",3]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"conflicting_replay"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
checkpoint state is the initial accumulator. Input: {"events":[["e1",2]],"initial":7}. Expected bounded report: 9. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
empty replay preserves the checkpoint. Input: {"events":[],"initial":7}. Expected bounded report: 7. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
a negative delta is retained as a correction. Input: {"events":[["e1",5],["e2",-2]]}. Expected bounded report: 3. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
zero delta remains a distinct event. Input: {"events":[["zero",0],["one",1]]}. Expected bounded report: 1. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
nonadjacent duplicate does not accumulate twice. Input: {"events":[["a",2],["b",3],["a",2]]}. Expected bounded report: 5. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an already seen checkpoint event is ignored. Input: {"events":[["a",4],["b",2]],"initial":4,"seen":{"a":4}}. Expected bounded report: 6. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

checkpoint conflict refuses the entire replay. Input: {"events":[["a",5]],"initial":4,"seen":{"a":4}}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"conflicting_replay"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

equal arm totals match within the cap. Input: {"arms":[[2,3],[1,4]],"cap":5}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":true,"totals":[5,5],"within_cap":true}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

unequal totals remain unmatched. Input: {"arms":[[2,3],[2,2]],"cap":5}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":false,"totals":[5,4],"within_cap":true}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

matched overspend still violates the cap. Input: {"arms":[[3,3],[2,4]],"cap":5}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":true,"totals":[6,6],"within_cap":false}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

empty arm totals are zero. Input: {"arms":[[],[]],"cap":0}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":true,"totals":[0,0],"within_cap":true}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

one arm cannot establish a matched comparison. Input: {"arms":[[1]],"cap":2}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"two_arms_required"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

negative cost cannot conceal consumption. Input: {"arms":[[4,-1],[3]],"cap":3}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"nonnegative_integer_required"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

boolean cost cannot masquerade as one token. Input: {"arms":[[true],[1]],"cap":2}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"nonnegative_integer_required"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

exact cap equality is permitted. Input: {"arms":[[7],[7]],"cap":7}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":true,"totals":[7,7],"within_cap":true}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

uneven granularity does not change total comparison. Input: {"arms":[[1,1,1,1],[4]],"cap":4}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":true,"totals":[4,4],"within_cap":true}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an overspent single arm blocks budget acceptance. Input: {"arms":[[5],[3]],"cap":4}. Expected bounded report: {"matched":false,"totals":[5,3],"within_cap":false}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an alternating allocation is balanced. Input: {"sequence":["A","B","A","B"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":2,"B":2,"imbalance":0}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

one extra A is explicitly imbalanced. Input: {"sequence":["A","B","A"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":2,"B":1,"imbalance":1}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an empty allocation reports zero assignments. Input: {"sequence":[]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":0,"B":0,"imbalance":0}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

all-A allocation reports its full imbalance. Input: {"sequence":["A","A","A"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":3,"B":0,"imbalance":3}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

all-B allocation reports its full imbalance. Input: {"sequence":["B","B"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":0,"B":2,"imbalance":2}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

blocked ordering can still have balanced totals. Input: {"sequence":["A","A","B","B"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":2,"B":2,"imbalance":0}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
unknown arm label is refused. Input: {"sequence":["A","C"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_arm"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

a missing assignment is not silently dropped. Input: {"sequence":["A",null]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_arm"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
case drift is not an arm alias. Input: {"sequence":["a","B"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_arm"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

equal counts do not supply a randomness test. Input: {"sequence":["B","A","A","B","B","A"]}. Expected bounded report: {"A":3,"B":3,"imbalance":0}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

disjoint evaluator and key-holder sets remain separated. Input: {"evaluators":["e1"],"key_holders":["k1"]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
a shared evaluator is reported. Input: {"evaluators":["e1","e2"],"key_holders":["e2"]}. Expected bounded report: ["e2"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

multiple overlaps are sorted reproducibly. Input: {"evaluators":["z","a"],"key_holders":["z","a"]}. Expected bounded report: ["a","z"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

no assigned evaluator supplies no overlap evidence. Input: {"evaluators":[],"key_holders":["k1"]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
no key holder leaves the relation empty. Input: {"evaluators":["e1"],"key_holders":[]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

duplicate evaluator entry is refused. Input: {"evaluators":["e1","e1"],"key_holders":[]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_role_member"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

duplicate key-holder entry is refused. Input: {"evaluators":[],"key_holders":["k1","k1"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_role_member"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
role aliases are not resolved implicitly. Input: {"evaluators":["E1"],"key_holders":["e1"]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
unassigned roles stay visibly vacant. Input: {"evaluators":[],"key_holders":[]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

partial overlap does not clear the remaining conflict. Input: {"evaluators":["e1","e2","e3"],"key_holders":["e1","e3","k"]}. Expected bounded report: ["e1","e3"]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

observed and missing rows both remain in the denominator. Input: {"rows":["observed","missing"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":0,"missing":1,"observed":1,"total":2}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

exclusions remain explicit. Input: {"rows":["observed","excluded"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":1,"missing":0,"observed":1,"total":2}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

empty planned cohort reports zero rows. Input: {"rows":[]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":0,"missing":0,"observed":0,"total":0}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

all-missing data never becomes an observed cohort. Input: {"rows":["missing","missing"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":0,"missing":2,"observed":0,"total":2}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

all-excluded rows remain countable. Input: {"rows":["excluded","excluded"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":2,"missing":0,"observed":0,"total":2}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

all-observed fixture retains full count. Input: {"rows":["observed","observed","observed"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":0,"missing":0,"observed":3,"total":3}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
unknown disposition is refused. Input: {"rows":["lost"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_disposition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
null disposition is not imputed. Input: {"rows":[null]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_disposition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

mixed dispositions sum to the planned total. Input: {"rows":["observed","missing","excluded","observed"]}. Expected bounded report: {"excluded":1,"missing":1,"observed":2,"total":4}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

case changes do not alter the disposition vocabulary. Input: {"rows":["Observed"]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"unknown_disposition"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
odd sample median is an observed fixture member. Input: {"stat":"median","values":[1,3,5]}. Expected bounded report: "3". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
even median is the exact middle-pair mean. Input: {"stat":"median","values":[1,3,5,7]}. Expected bounded report: "4". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
fractional mean retains its denominator. Input: {"stat":"mean","values":[1,2,2]}. Expected bounded report: "5/3". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
signed values retain cancellation. Input: {"stat":"mean","values":[-2,0,2]}. Expected bounded report: "0". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
sample variance uses n minus one. Input: {"stat":"sample_variance","values":[1,2,3]}. Expected bounded report: "1". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
population variance uses n. Input: {"stat":"population_variance","values":[1,2,3]}. Expected bounded report: "2/3". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
empty mean is refused. Input: {"stat":"mean","values":[]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"insufficient_data"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

singleton sample variance is refused. Input: {"stat":"sample_variance","values":[3]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"insufficient_data"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
singleton population variance is zero. Input: {"stat":"population_variance","values":[3]}. Expected bounded report: "0". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

an outlier changes the mean without changing the median. Input: {"stat":"median","values":[1,2,99]}. Expected bounded report: "2". A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

aligned pair labels yield A-minus-B differences. Input: {"a":[["p1",4],["p2",7]],"b":[["p1",1],["p2",5]]}. Expected bounded report: [["p1","3"],["p2","2"]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

reordered B rows align by label. Input: {"a":[["p1",4],["p2",7]],"b":[["p2",5],["p1",1]]}. Expected bounded report: [["p1","3"],["p2","2"]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

unpaired A label refuses silent dropping. Input: {"a":[["p1",4]],"b":[]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"pair_set_mismatch"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

unpaired B label refuses silent expansion. Input: {"a":[],"b":[["p1",1]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"pair_set_mismatch"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

duplicate A labels are refused. Input: {"a":[["p1",1],["p1",2]],"b":[["p1",1]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_pair"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

duplicate B labels are refused. Input: {"a":[["p1",1]],"b":[["p1",1],["p1",2]]}. Expected bounded report: {"error":"duplicate_pair"}. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
negative difference retains its sign. Input: {"a":[["p1",1]],"b":[["p1",4]]}. Expected bounded report: [["p1","-3"]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
zero difference is retained. Input: {"a":[["p1",4]],"b":[["p1",4]]}. Expected bounded report: [["p1","0"]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
empty pair sets produce zero comparisons. Input: {"a":[],"b":[]}. Expected bounded report: []. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.

A input order defines the output order. Input: {"a":[["p2",5],["p1",2]],"b":[["p1",1],["p2",3]]}. Expected bounded report: [["p2","2"],["p1","1"]]. A locally consistent report cannot establish real observations or authority.
